title: Chapter 33
text:
In the internal meeting room of Division 13, the director, deputy director, thirteen ministers, and fifteen high-ranking officials were gathered together to discuss only one topic: how to deal with Han Xiao.

"Han Xiao has a lot of confidential information. With his help, we can accurately attack the various bases of the Germinal Organization. Furthermore, he is a mechanic and has a certain level of combat power. His level is equivalent to that of a trained elite agent, but he has not reached the level of a superhuman. He has the sincerity to cooperate …" The head of the intelligence department finished his report and gave his opinion. "I think we can trust Han Xiao and cooperate with him."

Everyone looked at each other and remained silent for a few seconds. The head of the internal affairs department was the first to object. "No, what if Han Xiao gave us false information?"

It really came!

All the ministers were excited. Division 13 was divided into two factions. The head of the internal affairs department was led by the head of the internal affairs department, and the head of the intelligence department was led by the conservatives. The seats of the two sides were very clear, as if they were separated by the Chu River and Han River.

The head of the intelligence department explained, "The chances of that are very small. He is a fugitive of the Germinal Organization. If he wants to live, he can only rely on our protection, so there is no need to doubt his sincerity."

"Then he could be a spy sent by the Germinal Organization to put on a show!" The head of the internal affairs department did not give up and said in a deep voice, "I suggest that we control Han Xiao and lock him up secretly. We can get all the information out of him. Division 13 does not need to negotiate with anyone!"

"You are messing around! There is no need for that at all. Using force will only cause unforeseen accidents. Han Xiao is very sincere. We cannot push away the support that should be ours and make enemies for no reason! "

"That is a coward's compromise!"

"That's because you're brainless!"

Under the leadership of the two ministers, the two factions started to argue. Although both sides wanted to get information on Han Xiao, the contradiction between the two sides was that the hardliners wanted to imprison Han Xiao, while the conservatives wanted to cooperate with Han Xiao. They were arguing so much that they wanted to roll up their sleeves and fight it out.

There were two directors in Division 13. The director was the actual person in charge of Division 13, and the deputy director was a bureaucrat sent by the higher-ups to supervise them. He was also known as the administrative director.

Logically speaking, with such an organizational structure, there should be a sharp power struggle, but this Deputy Director was very low-key and did not care about anything. At this time, he was even thinking about what to eat after work. In view of the fact that the previous Deputy Director, who was ambitious and wanted to seize power, was inexplicably convicted of treason, his low profile was understandable.

The bureau chief was a dignified man. He said thoughtfully, "We need to cooperate and control the other party. Isn't this easy to solve? Can't we just recruit him into the bureau?"

The entire hall went from noisy to quiet in an instant. The ministers of the hardline faction were dumbfounded.

Are you trying to stir up trouble?

The hardliners immediately.

"Absolutely not!"

"What if Han Xiao is a spy sent by the enemy?"

"This is a violation of confidentiality!"

The director said firmly, "According to the rules, we will vote!"

The hardliners laughed and supported the director. Other than one neutral director, both sides had exactly six people. With the director's vote, the proposal was passed without a hitch.

The hardliners were stunned. You guys are colluding with each other!

Since the decision to recruit Han Xiao into Division 13 had been made, the next thing to discuss was which department he should join.

The internal affairs director said, "I think the logistics department is the most suitable for him. If he stays in the headquarters, we can monitor him at all times and make use of his mechanic skills."

The hardliners agreed this time. The logistics department was the most suitable for Han Xiao. He was not allowed to go out, and if he stayed under their watch, he would not be able to cause any trouble.

The director suddenly said, "Since Han Xiao is capable of fighting, why don't we transfer him to the covert operations department? There might be a surprise."

The atmosphere suddenly became awkward. All the directors looked at the neutral director who was dozing off. It was the director of the covert operations department.

"Hey, what does this have to do with me?" The director of the covert operations department was confused.

"Then it's settled. Actions may lie, words may lie, but goals will not lie. As long as we can confirm that the information Han Xiao gave us about the Germinal base is correct, we will let him join the covert operations department."

The director waved his hand and made the final decision.

All the directors facepalmed. Fine, you're the boss. As long as you're happy.

The deputy director yawned.

"Is it time to get off work? What's the food in the cafeteria today? "

…

After the meeting, the intelligence director and the logistics director went to the logistics department together to study the captured lightweight mechanical arm.

They wanted to see what was so special about Han Xiao's machine. If possible, they wanted to reverse engineer the blueprints and learn more about Han Xiao.

The person in charge of the research was the ace of the logistics department, Luo Xuan. He was once a top student in the Western Capital Academy and had been specially recruited into the logistics department of Division 13 after graduation. His performance had always been excellent, and the higher-ups seemed to have the intention of letting him join the covert operations department.

Other than being a little too proud, he had no other shortcomings.

Luo Xuan wore a pair of rubber gloves, and his face was calm. He had done this job many times before, so he was very familiar with it.

"Let's begin."

Luo Xuan started to disassemble the machine, but he suddenly paused and said in surprise, "There are security measures inside."

The security measures prevented anyone from dismantling the machine to derive the blueprints, which were all interconnected with the overall structure. Han Xiao's [Basic Assembly] knowledge included the method of security measures. Coupled with his max level [Simple Enhancement Modification], it would be impossible for anyone to crack the security measures unless they were an official Grade E Mechanic. He valued the Lightweight Mechanical Arm a lot, and he had predicted that it would fall into the hands of Division 13, so he had set up security measures early on.

The first generation Ranger had also set up security measures, but since it had already self-destructed, it could be ignored.

"Can you crack it?" the intelligence director asked.

"No problem." Luo Xuan was very confident. Removing the security measures was an indirect battle between the creator and the one who cracked it. Luo Xuan was very confident. How good could an unknown mechanic be? After all, he was a top student in the Western Capital Academy.

However, after twenty minutes, Luo Xuan still had not made any progress. He was sweating profusely and said in disbelief, "Four security measures? Is the guy who made this machine crazy? "

Four security measures were extremely complicated. If he disassembled it wrongly, the entire machine would automatically disintegrate. Luo Xuan was not confident.

The intelligence director frowned and said, "Can you do it or not? Don't waste my time."

Luo Xuan could not maintain his expression anymore. He did not dare to get angry at the director, so he could only swallow his anger and say, "This security measure is too complicated. I … I need time."

"Enough, I don't have that much free time. Tell me what you think."

Luo Xuan sensed the distrust of the intelligence director, and his expression turned ugly. He vented his anger and said, "There are no highlights in the technology, only the security measures are good. It makes me feel like the creator is a country bumpkin who treats trash like treasure."

The intelligence director raised his eyebrows and did not say anything. He asked someone to take the mechanical arm and leave the logistics department.

Since Han Xiao had killed a veteran mercenary with one punch, he felt that the best way to test it was to let the agents use it in actual combat. Coincidentally, the bureau was sending people to destroy the three Germinal Organization strongholds that Han Xiao had told them about. It was a good opportunity.

Unfortunately, the robot had been blown up into a pile of unrecognizable charred parts. He was more interested in the first generation ranger.

Although Division 13 was powerful, no one would complain about having too many new equipment.

The bunch of idiots in the R&D department, who had been receiving the most funding for the past few years, only knew how to create weird things. Sticky bombs with adhesive on both sides, arc-shaped machine guns that could not be aimed at, fake breasts that could block metal detectors and used to hide poison needles, and there were even f * cking male and female versions.

After two agents were sent to the hospital because of their own poison needles, the R&D department was blacklisted by the other agents.

…

The director held his phone and called the tall old man.

"I have already recommended Han Xiao to the Covert Operations Department."

"Thank you for your hard work."

The director was confused. "Old man, is he worth this much?"
